text:
Ryan Greene is one of four young centers learning on the job in Chicago, and Scott Powers of The Athletic noted the Blackhawks are last in the league in faceoffs. Greene has 4 points in 23 games on 14:40 a night and is pointless in nine straight, with the chances thinning out over that run too.

The bad luck is real, though. The Blackhawks have scored 7.3 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, and that kind of gap usually closes. Their share of five-on-five shot attempts with him on is only 40%, yet it's better than without him, which says as much about the roster as about Greene. Evolving-Hockey had his teammates in the bottom 1% by impact last season.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows a center who gets the puck out cleanly (69% of exits with possession) but rarely carries it in. The forwards picked around 57th overall who stuck scored a median 0.29 points a game in their first full season; he's at 0.17. Our projection: 17 to 31 points.
